unk_00.name: pursueCloseTime
unk_00.desc: Frames the tracked target has stayed within vf_14C range and only potentially visible during PursueTarget (+=deltaTime); pursuit holds while under flt_427400 (90). Zeroed when a pursuit starts

unk_04.name: grenadeHintPos
unk_04.desc: Points of up to 3 grenade-hint path nodes (kind 0xF/0x10, within 1000) found by the EnableGrenadeHints scheduler (sub_31E20); sp_sub_16540 hands one to a grenade thrower as the aim point

unk_1048.name: coverSearchReq
unk_1048.desc: Node search request for cover (defend area/advance/follow, sub_244E0/sub_25180) and near-owner node checks (sub_27CC0); results in coverResults

unk_10A8.name: attackSearchTargetPos
unk_10A8.desc: Meant as target position at the last attack-pos search (skip if target moved <300); never written (stays 0) so the reuse test only holds near origin

unk_10B4.name: attackSearchOwnerPos
unk_10B4.desc: Owner position at the last attack-position search; search reused while owner within 300 (flat)

unk_10C0.name: attackSearchTarget
unk_10C0.desc: Handle of the tracked entity the attack-position search was made for; sub_19F30 compares it with unk_1374

unk_10C4.name: attackPosResults
unk_10C4.desc: 10 attack-position results (type_154C0_F80); first 5 shuffled randomly; tried in order via attackPosIndex

unk_1114.name: attackPosSearchReq
unk_1114.desc: Node search for an attack position near the tracked entity (filter 9: within vf_114, beyond vf_14C+100, this side, LOS), A* type 9 (sub_28F30)

unk_1174.name: attackPosIndex
unk_1174.desc: Index of the attackPosResults entry last tried (-1 after a new search); next one's point goes to unk_5B0

unk_1178.name: coverHoldTime
unk_1178.desc: Random 30-120 s (x60 frames) to stay at an ordinary cover node before moving on (compared with state time unk_57C); drawn by sub_17AB0 action 1

unk_117C.name: vehicleCoverPath
unk_117C.desc: Path to a vehicle cover point (type_154C0_12F4 on a vehicle): sub_29780 (radius 5000, kind 5, pool 2) from the vehicle-cover search; success commits unk_1354 to unk_1324 (VehicleCoverPointFound). State 36.

unk_12F4.name: vehCoverHeld
unk_12F4.desc: Vehicle cover point the AI occupies (claimed via sub_23050). "SetVehicleCoverPoint" moves the selection unk_133C in here; states 35-37 head for or check it.

unk_130C.name: vehCoverPrev
unk_130C.desc: Previously held vehicle cover point (old unk_12F4 on release/replace); the search (sub_24BA0) will not pick it again.

unk_1324.name: vehCoverFound
unk_1324.desc: Vehicle cover point the search found and planned a path to (sub_24BA0); copied to the selection unk_133C on "VehicleCoverPointFound"; cleared when the search is off or the type changes.

unk_133C.name: vehCoverSelected
unk_133C.desc: Selected vehicle cover point (copy of unk_1324); "OccupyVehicleCoverpointSelected" claims it and "SetVehicleCoverPoint" makes it the held one, then resets it.

unk_1354.name: vehCoverPending
unk_1354.desc: Vehicle cover candidate stored before the path is planned (sub_24BA0); sub_23550(0) promotes it to unk_1324; the search skips it.

unk_136C.name: vehCoverSearch
unk_136C.desc: Vehicle cover point search enabled ("Set/GetVehicleCoverPointSearch"); sub_24BA0 does nothing while it is 0; setting 0 clears unk_1324.

unk_1370.name: vehicleToFollow
unk_1370.desc: Vehicle set by "SetVehicleToFollow" (kind bits 0x40080 only). With flag 22 the vehicle cover search only looks at this vehicle's cover points.

unk_1374.name: target
unk_1374.desc: Entity the AI tracks or attacks. sub_18BB0 sets it, saves the old one in unk_137C, resets the tracking timers and fires "FoundTarget"/"LostTarget".

unk_1378.name: targetTime
unk_1378.desc: Frames (1/60 s) the current target has been tracked; grows each update while a target exists; reset on target change; under 60 = newly acquired (target scoring).

unk_137C.name: prevTarget
unk_137C.desc: Last target: set on a target change and copied from unk_1374 in combat states 8-13/16-29. Behaviour state 0x11 heads to its last known point, then clears it.

unk_1380.name: chaseTargetPos
unk_1380.desc: Target's position when the vehicle-driving AI last planned its chase path (sub_1C880). Replans after 300 frames or when target moves >1500. Not a general last-seen point.

unk_138C.name: unused138C
unk_138C.desc: Only written: the constructor zeroes it. No reader in the recovered source.

unk_1390.name: lastAttacker
unk_1390.desc: Entity that last damaged this AI. Set by sub_18DA0 from the damage handlers (hit message unk_0C) when the attacker has an AI object; adds weight in target scoring.

unk_1394.name: timeSinceHit
unk_1394.desc: Frames since unk_1390 last hit it (1e37 at start; reset to 0 on each hit). Under 120 = attacker preferred; "ShouldIDoTheAssaultWalk" needs the player's value over 300.

unk_1398.name: prevNodeMemory
unk_1398.desc: Frames to keep remembering the node just left (unk_F58): 120 for kind 0x11, 0 for 0x0E, 21600 for 0x13, else 480. Counts down; at expiry unk_F58 is cleared. 1e37 = none.

unk_139C.name: shotBlockFrac
unk_139C.desc: Fraction (0..1) along the line of fire to the target's aim point where the nearest blocker is. Set by the line tests in sub_41B20 and vf_134; over 0.9 sets unk_534. Reset on target change.

unk_13A0.name: defendAreaKey
unk_13A0.desc: Key (two words) of the defend-area object (kinds 0x2C-0x2E) whose point the area follows ("SetDefendArea"); zero for a point or entity area.

unk_13A8.name: defendAreaCentre
unk_13A8.desc: Defend area centre (flag 13); follows the anchor entity/object each update. "SetupDefendAreaGotoPoint" copies it to the target point.

unk_13B4.name: defendAreaRadius
unk_13B4.desc: Defend area radius ("GetDefendAreaRadius"); raised by 100 when it is under the anchor entity's size plus 100.

unk_13B8.name: defendAreaHeightUp
unk_13B8.desc: Defend cylinder height above the centre ("SetDefendAreaCylinder" arg 3); inside needs y < centre.y + this. 0 with unk_13BC 0 means a sphere.

unk_13BC.name: defendAreaHeightDown
unk_13BC.desc: Defend cylinder depth below the centre ("SetDefendAreaCylinder" arg 4); inside needs y > centre.y - this. Minimum flt_4275B8 when nonzero.

unk_13C0.name: defendAreaEntity
unk_13C0.desc: Entity the defend area is centred on (an object with flag 2 holding an entity id); 0 for a point or object area.

unk_13C4.name: defendAreaDir
unk_13C4.desc: Defend area anchor's facing: the owner's facing for a point, the anchor's movement direction (updated after each move over dword_4275C8), or the object's direction.

unk_13D0.name: defendAreaAnchorPos
unk_13D0.desc: Defend area anchor position, updated only after the anchor moves past dword_4275C8. "SetupDefendAreaAnchorPosGotoPoint" copies it to the target point.

unk_13DC.name: defendAreaMode
unk_13DC.desc: Follow-frame mode of the defend area (same values as unk_1404); always set to 3 = use centre unk_13A8 and face away horizontally. 0/1/2/4 would use the anchor position.

unk_13E0.name: defendPursueDelay
unk_13E0.desc: Frames before a defend-area AI may chase its target again: 2700 when the target is out of the area, or 1-5 s random (x60). Counts down to 0; reset on target change.

unk_13E4.name: registeredFollowed
unk_13E4.desc: Entity registered as followed ("RegisterEntityFollowed"). Holds a follower count on it (sub_D3FF0/sub_D4170) so it records its own trail direction/point that followers copy.

unk_13E8.name: followTarget
unk_13E8.desc: Entity the AI currently follows ("SetCurrentEntityFollowed" / "...OnSpline"); takes priority over the defend area as the follow frame.

unk_13EC.name: followDir
unk_13EC.desc: Follow target's horizontal heading: its movement direction (after each move past the threshold), or the spline direction while following on a spline.

unk_13F8.name: followPoint
unk_13F8.desc: Follow target's last trail point (position stored after each move past the threshold), or the spline point; used as the follow position except in modes 3/4.

unk_1404.name: followMode
unk_1404.desc: Follow mode ("SetCurrentEntityFollowed" arg 2, 0-4 or -1; default 3). 3 = target's live position, also face away; 4 = live position unless on a spline; others = trail point.

unk_1408.name: followSplineKey
unk_1408.desc: Key (two words with unk_140C) of the spline object followed ("SetCurrentEntityFollowedOnSpline" arg 6); zeroed when following without a spline.

unk_1410.name: followSpline
unk_1410.desc: Spline path being followed (object's unk_24); non-null = following on a spline (sub_212A0).

unk_1414.name: splineParam
unk_1414.desc: Furthest spline parameter (0..1) reached; over 0.9999 fires "FollowEntityOnSpline_ArrivedAtDestination".

unk_1418.name: splinePoint
unk_1418.desc: Spline point at unk_1414 (raised 40); range checks measure from it (sub_21610/sub_21790) and the spline leash centres on it.

unk_1424.name: splineMode
unk_1424.desc: Spline follow mode (script arg 2, 0 or 1; default -1). 0 = never move back along the spline; 1 = start direction toward the owner's nearest point.

unk_1428.name: splineLeash
unk_1428.desc: Spline leash (script arg 4): the spline point stops advancing while the followed entity is over this far from it at a similar height (within 200).

unk_142C.name: splineDefendRadius
unk_142C.desc: Defend radius around the spline point (script arg 5); positive = set a defend area there (sub_20370) that moves with the spline point.

unk_1430.name: goGoGoState
unk_1430.desc: GoGoGo order state (sub_1A5A0); -1 none ("DisableGoGoGo"). 1 = point path found; "FoundPointPathForGoGoGo" sets 2; 3 = done. Only -1/1/2/3 are ever set.

unk_1434.name: goGoGoTime
unk_1434.desc: Game time (dword_4B87C8, frames) stamped by "FinishedGoGoGo"; "DidIJustGoGoGo" = under 60 frames ago; vf_034 waits 60 past it. Cleared for states 3/none.

unk_1438.name: goGoGoPoint
unk_1438.desc: GoGoGo destination: 2000 (flt_3D9480) ahead of the owner along the player's facing, set on "PlayerDidGoGoGo"; the point to head for while unk_1430 is set.

unk_1444.name: coverSightCache
unk_1444.desc: Three cached line-of-sight results from cover nodes to a target point (sub_22370): reused when node and point match; slot choice keeps current node unk_F60 and unk_F54.

unk_28.name: grenadeHintDir
unk_28.desc: The at (facing) vectors of the unk_04 grenade-hint nodes; sp_sub_16540 accepts a node only when the thrower is on the right side of it

unk_480.name: unused_480
unk_480.desc: Only zeroed by the constructor; no other read or write found

unk_484.name: matchOrientationDir
unk_484.desc: Direction to turn to (script SetupMatchOrientation); states 20 (vehicle, sub_1CFE0) and 30 (sub_1A190) turn to it and log MatchedOrientation; state 10 passes it to an empty stub

unk_490.name: pad_490
unk_490.desc: 4 bytes never accessed (padding or dead field)

unk_494.name: fireWeaponIndex
unk_494.desc: Vehicle weapon slot (0/1/2) to fire, script FireWeaponXTimes arg 1; state 29 (sub_1F470) passes it to the vehicle's vf_2A8

unk_498.name: fireShotsLeft
unk_498.desc: Shots still to fire (FireWeaponXTimes arg 2); sub_1F470 decrements on each successful vf_2A8 and logs FireWeaponCompleted at 0

unk_49C.name: aiFlags
unk_49C.desc: AI flag word, set/cleared/tested by script SetAIFlag/ClearAIFlag/GetAIFlag (sub_16D70/sub_16DD0) and by code

bits.0: probe look/avoid: steer the vf_1C8 probe object toward followed entities/directions (sub_2E580); keeps probes alive (mask 0x840001)
bits.2: check path blocked by a line cast ahead (sub_2CE90); IsPathBlocked
bits.4: autonomous: AI picks its own actions (sub_33820), action timer runs; squad behaviours require it
bits.5: vision scans every enemy list, not just the target (sub_40FB0); cleared when disabled
bits.6: may be targeted by others/projectile generators (sub_3DE00); cleared when disabled
bits.7: vehicle: face the unk_580 entity when matching orientation; skips turret check in sub_1BFB0
bits.8: vehicle: face the unk_580 entity when matching orientation (sub_1CFE0)
bits.9: hold cover: attack from cover (actions 25/26) while at a cover state; exempt from tank alert
bits.10: facing blocked (script BlockFacing): no turning in sub_2D5C0
bits.11: vehicle: consider reversing at path start (set by sub_2B740, cleared by sub_1A950)
bits.13: has defend area (leash unk_13A8/unk_13B4); IsWithinDefendArea; set sub_1FF10/sub_20370, cleared sub_204E0
bits.14: invulnerable: cannot die at 0 hit points (sub_13C490, vf_064)
bits.15: strafe: keep facing/aiming at the tracked target while moving (sub_16D70 targets it)
bits.16: vehicle drives in reverse (sub_1B710 flips heading/throttle)
bits.17: vehicle may fire at the target while moving/attacking (sub_1C4F0)
bits.19: notified when it hits its target (TargetHit, sub_D2AD0)
bits.20: vehicle does not stop to fire (sub_1DB60, sub_1E210)
bits.21: vehicles stop for it rather than run it over (vf_060, vf_2D0, vf_2D8)
bits.22: vehicle cover only around its assigned vehicle unk_1370 (sub_24BA0, sub_F6FC0)
bits.24: defend-area centre unk_13A8 follows the steering point unk_D70 (sub_2AE00)
bits.25: path-block line check that stops (unk_59C) instead of rerouting (sub_2CE90)
bits.26: may be recruited by its squad behaviour (sub_1A1F0 asks unk_574's vf_024)
bits.27: vehicle stops at the end of its spline (sub_1B2B0, unk_4B4)
bits.28: vehicle always stops to fire, even at soft targets (sub_1E210)
bits.29: vehicle ignores blockers: never stops for entities in its path (vf_2D0)
bits.30: SetTurnMode turns toward the fixed point unk_500 instead of unk_4F0

unk_4A0.name: vehicleReversing
unk_4A0.desc: Vehicle steering (sub_1A950) is reversing to turn toward its point: set when the point is behind or a 3-point turn is chosen, cleared once facing it

unk_4A4.name: tankAttackRoute
unk_4A4.desc: Result of sub_1C880 (an attack-position route found, nonzero) for tank states 24/25/33; 0 forces a re-plan; cleared on arrival or when the target moves over 1500

unk_4A8.name: vehicleStateTimer
unk_4A8.desc: Per-state countdown in frames: attack pause 30 (AttackPauseFinished), lookout 60 (LookOutEntityEmerged), re-plan 300; state 22 uses <=0 as first-tick then sets 1e6

unk_4AC.name: attackPauseDir
unk_4AC.desc: Random -1/0/1 redrawn each attack pause in sub_1D2C0 (reset to 0 on entering states 16/34); nothing reads it

unk_4B0.name: vehiclePathBlocked
unk_4B0.desc: Recomputed each tick by type_3DBC78::vf_2D0 (1 when an entity it must not run over is ahead); logs Vehicle_PathBlocked/UnBlocked on change; vehicle states brake while set

unk_4B4.name: splineEndBraking
unk_4B4.desc: State 12: set with flag 27 near the spline's end within stopping distance of unk_4E4; vehicle brakes until speed < 1, then clears; reset on entering state 12/23

unk_4C.name: grenadeHintKind15Mask
unk_4C.desc: Bit n set when grenade-hint node n is of kind 0xF (else 0x10); picks which side test sp_sub_16540 applies. Cleared by sub_1FC70 (EnableGrenadeHints off)

unk_4E0.name: ridingVehicle
unk_4E0.desc: 1 while the entity rides a vehicle: set by script RideVehicle, cleared by StopRidingVehicle and on attach (sub_16BC0); read by GetRidingVehicle.

unk_4E4.name: destination
unk_4E4.desc: Point the current movement ends at: the path goal (unk_8AC.unk_20) on entering a path state, the spline end (states 12/23/32), own position (40). Script DistanceToDestination.

unk_4F0.name: turnTarget
unk_4F0.desc: Pointer to the point the AI turns/aims its body at (sub_17140; tracked entity position, unk_4F4, unk_D70, dive spot). Script SetTurnMode, CanTurnToTurnLocation. 0 = none.

unk_4F4.name: turnLocation
unk_4F4.desc: Storage for a turn point: script SetTurnLocationTo(x,y,z) writes it and makes it the turn target; states 35 copy the vehicle cover point here.

unk_50.name: grenadeHintCount
unk_50.desc: Number of valid entries (0-3) in unk_04/unk_28, from the node search; cleared by sub_1FC70

unk_500.name: turnLocationOverride
unk_500.desc: Turn point used instead of unk_4F0 while unk_49C flag 30 is set (SetTurnMode). Script SetTurnLocationOverrideTo(x,y,z).

unk_50C.name: turnTargetVelocity
unk_50C.desc: World velocity of the entity being turned to (its local velocity unk_D8/DC/E0 on its frame axes); SetTurnMode leads the turn point by it. Zeroed by sub_17140 and state changes.

unk_518.name: aiSlot
unk_518.desc: This AI's slot in the AIData slot table unk_438CA8 (-1 none); other AIs index their 32 unk_80 records and maneuvers their member arrays by it.

unk_51C.name: aiControl
unk_51C.desc: AI enabled (1 from ctor). Script GetAIControl/SetAIControl; cleared on death and failed cover spawn; maneuvers and orders skip the AI while 0.

unk_520.name: alerted
unk_520.desc: Alerted: set on acquiring a target (sub_18BB0) or seeing it (sub_425A0); selects the alerted view range (vf_10C). Script SetAlerted/IsAlerted.

unk_524.name: firing
unk_524.desc: Trigger held: soldier vf_1B0/vf_1B4 store the fire request here and pass it to the weapon; weapon messages re-pull the trigger while it is set.

unk_528.name: orientToCover
unk_528.desc: Request to face the cover node's orientation: script OrientToCoverPoint (sub_26A30) sets it; ClearCoverPoint and path-state entry clear it; tank state 26 aims along the node.

unk_52C.name: allowTargetLosLoss
unk_52C.desc: Script SetAllowTargetLOSLoss: when set, the attack-stand check (sub_14DF0) keeps attacking even when the target is not visible.

unk_530.name: holdCover
unk_530.desc: Set for soldiers spawned attacking from cover (trigger kind 5, action 1); while set and unk_58==3 maneuvers leave the member alone. Cleared when a new target is acquired.

unk_534.name: targetLineMostlyClear
unk_534.desc: 1 when the nearest blocker on the line to a player target is beyond 0.9 of it (with unk_139C); lets a recently seen target count as visible within 300 of its last point.

unk_538.name: hearClasses
unk_538.desc: Sound class mask heard (sub_3C980). Rewritten every update: -1 (all) while action unk_5C is 0, 4 (Idle) or 0x1A, else 0, so AIs only hear while idle. [all: -1 while idle, 0 otherwise]

unk_53C.name: hearKinds
unk_53C.desc: Sound kind mask heard (sub_3C980); 0x57 from the constructor, nothing else writes it. [0x57: default (bits 0,1,2,4,6)]

unk_54.name: nextSquadMember
unk_54.desc: Handle to the next entity in the owner's squad (type_3DF30) member list: the owner's vf_118/vf_11C get/set it; squad loops walk vf_118()

unk_540.name: hearSides
unk_540.desc: Side mask of sound sources heard (vs source unk_2C&7): the opposite side, 1 for owner side 2, 2 for side 1, 0 (any) otherwise. Sourceless sounds pass only for class 1.

unk_544.name: canShootStatus
unk_544.desc: Shooting path check result (sub_31C50, scheduled by sub_19010): 0 unknown, 1 blocked (ShootingPathBlocked), 2 clear. Script GetTargetsCanShootStatus.

unk_548.name: shootCheckArg
unk_548.desc: Passed as arg_8 to the owner's vf_134 shoot-path test; only ever cleared (sub_19010, ctor), so always 0.

unk_54C.name: contactFlags
unk_54C.desc: Contact report bits for script GetContactType (sub_22110 returns 1/2 and clears them); forced 0 while unk_558 runs.

bits.1: 0x2: 600 frames (10 s) in action 3/4/0x1A; cleared after 300 frames in other actions
bits.2: 0x4: tracked target unseen for over 600 frames (record unk_10); cleared on new target

unk_550.name: timeOutOfCombat
unk_550.desc: Frames spent in action unk_5C 3 (PursueTarget), 4 (Idle) or 0x1A (Idle); zeroed in any other action. Crossing 600 sets unk_54C bit 1. Keyed on unk_5C, not unk_578.

unk_554.name: timeInCombat
unk_554.desc: Frames spent in any other action (engaging); zeroed in actions 3/4/0x1A and by sub_22110. Over 300 clears unk_54C bit 1.

unk_558.name: contactCooldown
unk_558.desc: Countdown (frames) suppressing contact reports: while positive it decrements and keeps unk_54C 0. A maneuver (type_3CE5AC::vf_00C) sets 600.

unk_55C.name: astarCheckId
unk_55C.desc: Id of the registered A* search (script RegisterAStarCheck, sub_28A60); 0 none. UnRegisterAStarCheck and one-shot search types completing clear it.

unk_560.name: astarCheckScriptFile
unk_560.desc: Debug: name of the script file (char*, dword_449288) that registered the A* check.

unk_564.name: astarCheckScriptLine
unk_564.desc: Debug: script line number (dword_449284) that registered the A* check.

unk_568.name: owner
unk_568.desc: The entity this AI object belongs to (sub_16BC0 attaches, sub_16C50 clears).

unk_56C.name: squad
unk_56C.desc: The squad/group (type_3DF30) the entity is in (sub_17030). Script SetSquadLeader, SetManeuverType, SuggestManeuver go through it.

unk_570.name: squadId
unk_570.desc: The squad's id (its unk_2B4), kept so sub_3EE10 can put the entity back in the same squad; 0 none.

unk_574.name: maneuver
unk_574.desc: Handle of the squad maneuver (type_3CE4B4 subclass) the AI takes part in; resolved by sub_3D3E0. Script GetManeuverType returns its vf_030.

unk_578.name: aiMode
unk_578.desc: AI mode/state, set only by script SetAIMode (sub_17BF0), read by GetAIMode; sub_172F0 runs its handler each update. 0 = none.

values.1: follow A* path unk_5BC to an entity (FindAStarPathToAIObj), tracks it
values.2: follow A* path unk_5BC to a point/node
values.3: no setup or handler (steering range 125 only)
values.7: follow path unk_A24 to tracked target (pursue)
values.11: vehicle: drive path unk_A24 to target
values.12: vehicle: follow spline unk_D14, keep pace with unk_580
values.19: tank: pursue along path to moving target
values.20: tank: turn to orientation unk_484 / unk_580 (MatchedOrientation)
values.26: tank: attack from cover node (path unk_DDC)
values.27: tank: stop and aim at target
values.33: tank attack (24) for a crewed vehicle (vf_2DC)
values.34: attack pause (16) for a crewed vehicle
values.35: go straight to vehicle cover point
values.37: hold vehicle cover point, track target
values.41: path to defend area (TargetMoved vs unk_13A8)

unk_57C.name: modeTime
unk_57C.desc: Frames in the current mode unk_578: reset when SetAIMode changes it, advanced by sub_172F0; a maneuver tests mode 0x25 for over 180.

unk_58.name: actionState
unk_58.desc: State of the current AI action (script SetManeuverState): 0 idle (reselect), 1 just started (AIAction_* sent), 3 running/held (StopTask handoff or script), 2/4 finished (second handlers reset to 0)

unk_580.name: followEntity
unk_580.desc: Handle of the entity to follow/plan to: script SetEntityToFollow/GetEntityToFollow, sub_293A0 path targets; mode 14 faces it, sub_1A630 keeps pace with it.

unk_584.name: blockingEntity
unk_584.desc: Handle of the non-player entity blocking the path (sub_309E0, from the path line cast); 0 none.

unk_588.name: blockedTime
unk_588.desc: Frames the unk_584 entity has blocked the path; past flt_438D30 a same-side blocker is sent "BlockingEntity". Reset when the blocker changes.

unk_58C.name: followDistance
unk_58C.desc: Distance to keep from the follow entity (script SetEntityToFollow arg 2); sub_1A630 matches its speed within 1.2x of it.

unk_590.name: maxSpeedSeen
unk_590.desc: Highest owner speed seen (vf_0C8 length, updated each frame, never lowered); sub_1A630 scales speed by followEntitySpeed / this.

unk_594.name: pathCheckTimer
unk_594.desc: Frames accumulated by the path handlers, reset on mode entry; drives periodic checks (target moved every 30/60, vehicle cover moved every 15).

unk_598.name: pathBlocked
unk_598.desc: Path blocked (sub_30850; AStar_PathBlocked/UnBlocked, flag 23 or line cast without flag 25); movement stops heading for unk_D70. Script IsPathBlocked.

unk_59C.name: pathBlockedByEntity
unk_59C.desc: Path blocked by an entity under unk_49C flag 25 (sub_2CE90 line cast); cleared when clear and on mode change. Script IsPathBlocked ORs it with unk_598.

unk_5A0.name: pathBlockedWhileStrafing
unk_5A0.desc: Set with unk_598 when unk_49C flag 15 (face target while moving) is on; sub_2D3A0 then only turns (sub_2C220). Script IsPathBlockedWhileStrafing.

unk_5A4.name: autoReplan
unk_5A4.desc: Set by maneuvers/handlers via sub_29380; the A* scheduler only runs search types 0, 1 and 4 (sub_28C60) while it is set.

unk_5A8.name: goalNode
unk_5A8.desc: Path node to plan to: script FindAStarPathToPathNode plans unk_5BC to its point (sub_29540); maneuvers set it (with unk_F5C) before action 5.

unk_5AC.name: goalNodeIndex
unk_5AC.desc: Index paired with unk_5A8 (node search result index), passed to sub_29940 as the path's end node index (unk_64.unk_40).

unk_5B0.name: gotoPoint
unk_5B0.desc: Point to go to: SetupGotoPoint, SetCoverPointFromName, defend-area setups, dive spots, node searches; FindAStarPathToPoint plans to it; modes 22 and 40 drive to it.

unk_5BC.name: goalPath
